name: io.github.cyanheads/art-institute-chicago-mcp-server
description: Search the Art Institute of Chicago collection: artworks, artists, exhibitions, and audio guides.

tools.name: artic_search_artworks
tools.description: Search the Art Institute of Chicago collection by text and structured filters, ranked by relevance or sorted by date or acquisition year. Text matches all words across titles, artists, descriptions, provenance, and other catalog fields; common English words such as the and of are ignored. Filters combine with AND. Results reach the first 1,000 matches; narrow with filters for more. Set limit to 0 with facets to get only counts. Use artic_lookup_vocabulary for filter values and artic_get_artworks for full records.

query.description: Text matched against titles, artists, descriptions, provenance, and other catalog fields; every word must match, except common English words such as the and of, which are ignored. Supports "exact phrase", -exclude, and a | b.

artist.description: Artist or culture name matched against every credited artist (all words must match).

artist_id.description: Agent id from artic_search_artists or an artist facet row; matches preferred and other credits.

department.description: Department title exactly as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored), such as Prints and Drawings.

artwork_type.description: Artwork type title as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored), such as Painting or Print.

style.description: Style title as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored), such as Impressionism; matches preferred or alternate styles.

subject.description: Subject title as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored).

classification.description: Classification title as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored), such as oil on canvas or etching.

material.description: Material title as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored), such as ink or gold leaf.

technique.description: Technique title as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored), such as black-and-white photography or plain weaving.

theme.description: Theme title as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored), such as Women artists.

place_of_origin.description: Place of origin as artic_lookup_vocabulary lists it (case ignored), such as france.

gallery.description: Gallery where the work is on view, such as Gallery 240 (a bare 240 is read as Gallery 240). Only on-view works carry a gallery.

year_from.description: Earliest year; a work matches when its date span overlaps year_from to year_to. Negative for BCE.

year_to.description: Latest year; a work matches when its date span overlaps year_from to year_to. Negative for BCE.

acquired_from.description: Earliest fiscal year in which the museum acquired the work (acquisition_fiscal_year), inclusive. Works with no recorded acquisition year never match, so this filter alone never gives a complete provenance-review set.

acquired_to.description: Latest fiscal year in which the museum acquired the work (acquisition_fiscal_year), inclusive. Works with no recorded acquisition year never match.

provenance.description: recorded keeps only works whose record carries provenance text; unrecorded keeps only works whose record carries none. The filter reads whether text is present, which says nothing about whether the provenance is complete. With acquired_from or acquired_to, works with no recorded acquisition year are still left out.

public_domain_only.description: Only public-domain works, whose images are CC0.

on_view_only.description: Only works on view at the museum now.

facets.description: Facet counts to compute over the filtered set (top 15 values each), any or all of: department, artwork_type, style, subject, classification, material, technique, theme, place_of_origin, gallery, artist. An array or a comma-separated string.

sort.description: relevance ranks by query text, or by museum popularity without it. date_asc and date_desc sort by start year: works without one come last, and records with a placeholder start year (outside -8000 to 2100) are left out. acquired_desc (recent acquisitions first) and acquired_asc sort by acquisition fiscal year, with works that have no recorded fiscal year last.

page.description: Page to return (1-based). A page must start within the first 1,000 matches; one that crosses match 1,000 holds only the rows up to it.

limit.description: Requested rows per page (0-1,000); at most 100 are returned. 0 returns only totalCount and facets.

tools.name: artic_get_artworks
tools.description: Fetch full Art Institute of Chicago records for up to 100 artworks by id in one call, returning deferred_ids for the rest: description, provenance, exhibition and publication history, dimensions, inscriptions, credit line, categorization, gallery, image URLs with rights status, related multimedia, and links to the museum's online scholarly catalogue entries on the work (noncommercial terms returned with them). The long text sections are opt-in through sections; request the sections and ids your client can take, since every section on 100 well-documented works comes to about 1.5 MB. Ids come from artic_search_artworks, artic_search_exhibitions, or artic_search_artists.

ids.description: Artwork ids as an array or comma-separated string, up to 1,000 supplied entries including blanks and duplicates. Comma strings also have a 100,000-character ceiling. Artwork page URLs are read as their id; blanks and duplicates are dropped. Fetches the first 100; deferred_ids names the remainder.

sections.description: Heavy text sections to include: description (also short_description), provenance, exhibition_history, publication_history, catalogue. Defaults to description and provenance; pass an empty array for none.

include_related_media.description: Load what the records link to: sound recordings (lectures, audio stops) and text documents as related_media, and publication_sections. Up to 100 of each kind per call, one extra request per kind linked.

tools.name: artic_search_artists
tools.description: Find artists, cultures, and organizations in the Art Institute of Chicago collection by name, or fetch them by id. Each result carries life dates, agent type, alternate names, how many of the museum's artworks credit them, and up to three of their works, the museum's highlighted works first. Pass an id to artic_search_artworks as artist_id to browse all of their works.

query.description: Name to find, matched against names and alternate names; every word must match. Pass query or ids, not both.

ids.description: Agent ids as an array or comma-separated string, up to 1,000 supplied entries including blanks and duplicates. Comma strings also have a 100,000-character ceiling. Blanks and duplicates are dropped; fetches the first 100 and returns deferred_ids. Pass query or ids, not both; other filters and page apply to query only.

artists_only.description: Query mode: only agents the museum records as artists. Set false to include donors, funds, and organizations.

born_from.description: Query mode: earliest birth year, negative for BCE.

born_to.description: Query mode: latest birth year, negative for BCE.

page.description: Query mode: page to return (1-based). A page must start within the first 1,000 matches; one that crosses match 1,000 holds only the rows up to it.

limit.description: Query mode: requested agents per page (1-1,000); at most 100 are returned.

tools.name: artic_search_exhibitions
tools.description: Search Art Institute of Chicago exhibitions by text, date, artwork_id, or artist_id. Relationship filters cover recorded museum links; an absent link does not prove an artwork or artist never appeared in a show. For the full exhibition record of one artwork, read the exhibition_history section of artic_get_artworks. Results carry dates, gallery, summary, web page, and listed artworks. Pass artwork ids to artic_get_artworks for full records.

artwork_id.description: Exact museum artwork id, from artic_search_artworks or artic_get_artworks; matches recorded exhibition relationships. Combined with every other condition using AND.

artist_id.description: Exact museum agent id, from artic_search_artists or an artwork artist_id; matches recorded exhibition relationships. Combined with every other condition using AND.

query.description: Text matched against exhibition titles, descriptions, and other fields; every word must match, except common English words such as the and of, which are ignored.

when.description: current: open today; upcoming: opens after today; past: closed before today; any: no date condition. A show with no recorded closing date is past when marked Closed, else current from its opening.

date_from.description: Earliest date, YYYY-MM-DD; an exhibition matches when its run overlaps date_from to date_to. A show with no recorded closing date ran on its opening date alone when marked Closed, else runs on from its opening; one with only a closing date ran on that date alone; one with no dates matches no window.

date_to.description: Latest date, YYYY-MM-DD; an exhibition matches when its run overlaps date_from to date_to. Missing dates are read as described for date_from.

sort.description: relevance ranks by query text; start_desc and start_asc sort by opening date. Defaults to relevance with a query, else start_desc; relevance without a query sorts as start_desc.

page.description: Page to return (1-based). A page must start within the first 1,000 matches; one that crosses match 1,000 holds only the rows up to it.

limit.description: Requested exhibitions per page (1-1,000); at most 100 are returned.

tools.name: artic_search_audio_guide
tools.description: Search the Art Institute of Chicago's mobile audio-guide stops by text, matching stop titles and transcripts. Returns each stop's title, MP3 URL, and transcript text. Stops carry no artwork id, so match a stop to a work by its title; for a known artwork, artic_get_artworks related_media lists the recordings linked to it. Some stops are in Spanish, and titles are sometimes internal file names. This content is for noncommercial educational and personal use only: keep the copyright notice and cite the Art Institute of Chicago.

query.description: Text matched against stop titles and transcripts; every word must match, except common English words such as the and of, which are ignored. An artwork's title or the artist's surname works well.

page.description: Page to return (1-based). A page must start within the first 1,000 matches; one that crosses match 1,000 holds only the rows up to it.

limit.description: Requested stops per page (1-1,000); at most 100 are returned, each with its whole transcript.

tools.name: artic_lookup_vocabulary
tools.description: List the values of an Art Institute of Chicago collection vocabulary with how many artworks carry each, most common first, optionally narrowed by a substring. Each value passes to the artic_search_artworks filter of the same name exactly as listed (case is ignored). Counts here span the whole collection; for counts within a filtered set of artworks, request facets from artic_search_artworks.

vocabulary.description: Vocabulary to list; its values feed the artic_search_artworks filter of the same name.

contains.description: Case- and accent-insensitive substring the values must contain, such as "impress" for Impressionism and Post-Impressionism, or "applique" for appliqué (technique). Omit to list the most common values.

limit.description: Values to return, most common first (1-1,000). Narrow with contains for more specific values.
